plan.change: Phase C3-3 prerequisite: preauthorize the authenticated human attestation verifier blob.
expectedChanges: Change only the trusted static registry to preauthorize the exact future Git blob for tools/change-verification-check.cjs.
Move transitionPolicy from steady to one-path pending for tools/change-verification-check.cjs while leaving the contracted verifier file itself unchanged.
Do not install or execute the future human attestation verifier in this authorization PR.
hqDecisions: C3-3 human attestation parsing will be implemented inside the already-contracted change-verification-check.cjs rather than in an uncontracted trusted executable.
The future verifier accepts a GitHub-authenticated issue-comment attestation only when it covers exactly all locked Plan manualChecks for the exact current PR head SHA.
The attestation artifact records GitHub user identity, association, comment identity/body hash, exact PR/base/head, Plan digest, and verifier blob while keeping final verificationState UNVERIFIED.
This PR is registry-only preauthorization; candidate registry cannot authorize its own current PR.
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: Registry-only authorization package; authenticated human attestation is the later C3-3 target, not a prerequisite for this bootstrap step.
plan.rollback: Close or revert this staging-only registry authorization if the future verifier blob changes before installation.
unverified: The preauthorized verifier is not trusted until a later fresh PR installs exactly blob 7f54001a813dd89fa65018b780a18c25a7141b0b and returns registry transitionPolicy to steady.
plan.problem: C3-3 needs a base-owned authenticated human attestation verifier, but tools/change-verification-check.cjs is protected by the C3-2 exact-blob contract and requires prior merged authorization.
plan.currentContract: staging/main is steady and expects tools/change-verification-check.cjs blob e207027a3a59a0261f4b303fe8b9fcb86a8d2b30.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The current verifier treats recordedBy and manualChecks PASS as candidate-authored strings and has no GitHub-authenticated human attestation mode.
plan.design: Preauthorize future verifier blob 7f54001a813dd89fa65018b780a18c25a7141b0b using the existing steady-to-pending registry transition. The future verifier validates a created PR issue comment from a human repository-associated GitHub User, binds it to same-repository default-branch PR metadata, exact current head SHA, immutable Plan Lock digest/base SHA, and the exact complete Plan manualChecks set, records comment/user provenance and hashes without duplicating raw note/body, and always leaves verificationState UNVERIFIED.
alternativesRejected: Modify verifier and registry in one PR; same-PR self-authorization is forbidden.
Add a new uncontracted trusted executable; security-critical code must remain inside the exact-blob contract set.
Trust candidate Verification Record recordedBy/manual PASS strings; they are self-declared.
Allow partial or extra manual check attestations in C3-3; one comment must cover exactly the locked manualChecks set.
Promote final VERIFIED from this evidence; final record integration is explicitly later.
plan.migration: No existing Verification Record or evidence is rewritten. This PR only creates a temporary pending registry state for one contracted path.
plan.compatibility: No workflow, verifier runtime, required status name, Plan schema, or production behavior changes in this package.
boundaryCases: Bot or non-User comment author is rejected.
Comment user and event sender login/id mismatch is rejected.
Author association outside OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR is rejected.
Fork PR or non-default-base PR is rejected.
Missing, duplicate, extra, or partial manual check IDs are rejected.
Plan with no manualChecks is rejected for attestation.
Malformed payload or unknown payload field is rejected.
Raw comment/note text is not copied into operator logs or attestation artifact; hashes and byte counts are retained.
Verifier source blob must match the base-owned expected blob.
testPlan: Require candidate Change Operations Tests to stay green during registry-only pending authorization.
Require Change PR Gate and Change Verification Evidence to pass.
Inspect trusted Static Evidence for REGISTRY_AUTHORIZATION_VALID.
Request exact-head Codex adversarial review and stop on new High/Medium finding.
Merge to staging only, then create a fresh verifier-install PR from the pending base.
plan.promotionRisk: None. Staging-only Change OS registry authorization.
